samples.text:
Degree Programs

There's no academic experience quite like Grainger Engineering. Ranked the #6 college of engineering with 13 top 5 programs from US News and World Report, we have a reputation of being the best of the best. But a lot goes into those numbers. Engaging professors. State-of-the-art facilities. Groundbreaking student resources. Brilliant classmates. Supportive environment. Endless opportunities. Whether you're a first year undergraduate or working toward a PhD, our programs are designed to help you become the engineer you want to be.

attributes-text.name: default
attributes-text.description: The ID of the tab that is open on load. This defaults to the first item in the list.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Color theme used. There is no orange theme because there would be a lot of bright colors on the screen.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width -- constrained to the container (default), full width, or full width but text is constrained (auto), or text is constrained to the page width (page).

attributes.name: horizontal
attributes.description: Whether or not to use the horizontal layout. Recommended to not use this unless there are a few tabs.

attributes.name: rounded
attributes.description: Whether or not to use rounded corners for the tabs.

css-variables.name: --ilw-tabs--display
css-variables.description: Flex or block for the tabs list (controls horizontal or vertical layout)

css-variables.name: --ilw-tabs--tablist--display
css-variables.description: Flex or block for the tabs button list (controls horizontal or vertical layout)

css-variables.name: --ilw-tabs--tablist--width
css-variables.description: Width of the tabs button list in vertical layout. Defaults to 350px.

css-variables.name: --ilw-tabs--max-width
css-variables.description: Max Width of the tabs control, defaults to auto.

css-variables.name: --ilw-tabs--padding
css-variables.description: Padding of the entire tab control.

css-variables.name: --ilw-tabs--color-control
css-variables.description: Color of the control in a rounded tab.

css-variables.name: --ilw-tabs--color-control-text
css-variables.description: Color of the text in a rounded control.
